Ivy (Finance): Heads-up: BeaconMetrics renewal landed with a 22% price increase. They also changed billing to include 'processing events' as a separate line. Can procurement evaluate alternatives?

Omar (Procurement): I'll open conversations. Two candidates: CostLens and MeterWave. CostLens seems cheaper for base, MeterWave charges per-processed-event. Need our last 9mo usage to compare.

Lina (Platform): BeaconMetrics current integration: daily batch CSV to S3 + REST API for on-demand lookups. If we switch, we need the export schema and TTL for webhooks. MeterWave offers incremental webhooks which might simplify things.

Marcus (Security): Before any POC, request SOC2 and encryption-at-rest docs. Also confirm whether vendors allow customer-managed keys. I'll add those to the checklist.

Ivy (Finance): Can someone pull monthly event counts and storage bytes for last 9 months by sku? Need to model per-event pricing.

Lina (Platform): I'll generate and upload a sanitized CSV to #finance-data by EOD. Sample:

```
month,sku,events,storage_gb
2024-08,billable_events,98000,5.6
2024-09,billable_events,110200,6.0
```

Omar (Procurement): I'll draft an RFP template: base fee, per-event, burst pricing, retention, migration assistance, SLA credits. Also ask for a one-time onboarding credit.

vendor-bot: BeaconMetrics uploaded renewal_offer_1779457000.pdf. Quote: $42,000/mo starting next term.

Ivy (Finance): Okay hold signing. Target ask: 15% off list + 3mo credit on 12mo commit. If alternatives beat TCO by >=10% and migration cost < $25k, consider switch.

Omar (Procurement): I'll reach out to CostLens and MeterWave and share the sanitized usage under NDA. Expect replies in 72h.

Marcus (Security): I'll prepare the security checklist and share with Procurement.

Ivy (Finance): Thanks. Reconvene after vendor replies. /remind me 3 days to follow up.
